svg.title: One question to the AI assistant
svg.desc: A question typed in the chat goes to the supervisor, which asks Gemini which specialist to use and hands it to Attendance_agent. That agent asks Gemini which tool to call, and the read-only hours tool gets the day from attendance.db through InteractWithDatabase. The hours come back up, or "no record" when there is none, and the supervisor streams the answer into the chat. Ask: 1. chat calls supervisor: the question. Delegate: 2. supervisor calls Gemini: pick agent. 3. Gemini replies to supervisor: attendance. 4. supervisor calls Attendance_agent: the question. 5. Attendance_agent calls Gemini: pick tool. 6. Gemini replies to Attendance_agent: hours tool. Look it up: 7. Attendance_agent calls hours tool: name and date. 8. hours tool sends to hours tool: read db. If a record for that day: 9a. hours tool replies to Attendance_agent: the hours. Otherwise: 9b. hours tool replies to Attendance_agent: no record, refused. Answer: 10. Attendance_agent replies to supervisor: the facts. 11. supervisor replies to chat: streamed answer.
